description: This file defines types and an in-memory store for managing conversation references in a Microsoft Teams bot. It includes types for conversation reference objects, store entries, and a store interface with methods to manage these references, supporting proactive messaging in MS Teams integrations.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Adds or updates a conversation reference associated with a conversation ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Finds the most recent personal DM conversation reference for a user, used for proactive messaging.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Deprecated; used to find conversation reference by user ID, similar to `findPreferredDmByUserId`.
